stem: The property uses the Blended reporting identity. The web and app teams start sending a user ID for every signed-in customer. A month later the product manager asks why the Users count fell while sessions and purchases held steady. What is the most likely explanation?

options.text: Google signals now joins the devices, which takes signed-in customers out of Users
Blended now models signed-in customers instead of counting them, which lowers Users
Customers who sign in on several devices now count as one user, not one per device
Signed-in customers are held back from reports until the property moves to Device-based
